out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN COOKING AREA TO HAVE A CONTAINER OF SOAPY WATER IN IT.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: CONTAINER REMOVED FROM SINK. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP HOLDING CHICKEN AT 55F AND HAM AT 49F (1.5HR). OBSERVED UNSALTED BUTTER ON COUNTER AT 75F (1.5HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: PIC TO THROW TCS FOODS IN PREP TOP EVERY FOUR HOURS. THERE IS LIMITED PREP SPACE IN FACILITY, AND THEY ARE WAITING ON A PART TO REPAIR COOLER. CDI: BUTTER PUT IN WORKING PREP-TOP COOLER.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED CREPE SPATULA HELD IN ~100F WATER. OBSERVED TWO SCOOPS IN DRY FOOD WITH HANDLES STORED INSIDE THE FOOD.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED. SCOOPS MUST HAVE HANDLES STORED OUTSIDE OF FOOD, AND THE SPATULA WATER WAS MOVED TO HOT HOLDING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP HOLDING FOOD 49-55F. PIC HAS ALREADY CALLED FOR MAINTENANCE AND THEY ARE WAITING ON A PART.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC AGREED TO HAVE TCS FOODS ON TPHC UNTIL COOLER IS FIXED. COOLER MUST BE FIXED BY MAY 16TH, 2026. I RECOMMEND IT IS SET 33-35F DUE TO THE PROXIMITY TO ELECTRIC BURNERS. Dulce Crepes (Inspection Date: 05/06/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall. OBSERVED NO COVERED TRASH IN WOMEN’S RESTROOM.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. A COVERED TRASH CAN SHALL BE SUPPLIED TO RESTROOM BY MAY 16TH.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: smoked salmon offered raw or undercooked in the establishment did not come in a ready to eat form from supplier and did not have a parasite destruction letter
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. PIC agreed to acquire a parasite destruction letter for the smoked salmon that is served raw or undercooked. Followed up with EHS that they switched smoked salmon products to a ready to eat version

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Design
violations.observation: Insect control device does not retain the insects within the device. Observed electric racket style fly swatter in the facility
violations.corrective_action: If insect control devices electrocute or stun insects, the device shall be designed to catch and hold the insects. PIC agreed to take home fly swatter Dulce Crepes (Inspection Date: 11/17/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ in the @Location@ is in need of cleaning. Observed walls of the kitchen, ceiling vents and the compressor vents for the Walk in cooler were in need of cleaning
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC agreed to have the cooler vents, vents in the ceiling and the walls in the facility cleaned

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM PRESENT AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Proper Temp
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding to a sufficient temperature and/or time: HOLLANDAISE IN WARMER OBSERVED AT 108F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding shall be reheated to a minimum temperature of 165F for 15 seconds. CFM RAISED TEMPERATURE OF UNIT SO HOLLANDAISE REACHED 165F WITHIN 2 HOURS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED UNLABELED SQUEEZE BOTTLE WITH NO CLEANER NAME.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM LABELLED SQUEEZE BOTTLE WITH “SOAP”,
